title: Euler characteristic of an invertible twist on an integral proper curve
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $C$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] of topological Krull dimension one [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_C$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $\mathcal F$ a coherent $\mathcal O_C$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $\xi$ be the generic point, characterized by $\overline{\{\xi\}}=C$. Its local ring is the residue field $\mathcal O_{C,\xi}=\kappa(\xi)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Set $r=\dim_{\kappa(\xi)}\mathcal F_\xi$, the finite dimension of the generic stalk [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. For the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], Euler characteristic [def-pc-euler-characteristic] and degree [def-pc-degree-line-bundle],
$$\chi(C,\mathcal L\otimes_{\mathcal O_C}\mathcal F)=r\deg_k(\mathcal L)+\chi(C,\mathcal F).$$
The generic rank $r$ may be zero; no local freeness of $\mathcal F$ or smoothness of $C$ is assumed.

from.place: The fibrewise ampleness-to-projectivity argument: positivity on normalized geometric-fibre components is converted to relative ampleness and then to a projective-bundle embedding. Supporting input: the proper integral curve degree criterion (0B5X). In the 0B5X proof this is the tensor-product degree formula used to pass from the degree of a positive tensor power to the degree of the line bundle and to obtain linear Euler-characteristic growth. Supporting input: the integral-curve Euler-characteristic calculation in the proof of Stacks 0AYX (via 0AYV).
